methodology: Each short independently worded action/component is attached to its single original source book and exact reprint article URL. Several adjacent components are parts of one described family custom; source mention total must NEVER be claimed as unique historical customs. Multiple pages from one original work do not constitute independent witnesses. Inherited Weiser, Trapp, Stokes, Parsch, other authors and secondary folklore may appear as citations and require provenance dependency control. No printed page numbers invented. No prayer, ritual text, recipe or full excerpt copied. Ritual approvals, relic claims and folk magic quarantined.
